title: Artemis II Astronaut Christina Koch Takes New NASA Leadership Role
detail: Artemis II crew member and NASA astronaut Christina Koch has assumed a new NASA role, with analysts examining potential implications for the Artemis II crew lineup and mission operations.

title: NASA Details Battery Engineering Approach for Moon's Extreme Temperature Swings
detail: NASA has detailed its engineering approach for batteries capable of withstanding the Moon's extreme temperature swings — a key technical challenge for sustained lunar surface operations during Artemis missions. Lunar surface temperatures range from approximately -280°F (-173°C) at night to 260°F (127°C) during the day.
